Frequently Asked Questions
What is AI video generation?
AI video generation uses machine learning models to create video clips from text prompts, images, or existing footage. Instead of filming every shot, you describe the scene and the model generates motion, style, and camera behavior.
How do I create AI video with Krea?
Open the Video Tool , choose a model, write a prompt, and click generate. You can refine results by changing the prompt, model, duration, or by adding start and end frame references.
What is the best AI video generator?
The best AI video generator depends on the result you want. Krea lets you run the same prompt or reference across multiple leading video models, compare the outputs, and choose the model that fits the motion, visual style, audio, or control your project needs.
Can I create an AI video from an image?
Yes. Upload a still image in the Video Tool and describe the motion you want, or set first and last frames for more control over how the shot begins, moves, and resolves.
Which AI video models can I use on Krea?
Krea’s current video workspace includes Seedance 2.5 , Veo 3.1 , Sora 2 , Kling , Wan 2.6 , and Runway , plus additional models inside the Video Tool .
How long are AI video clips on Krea?
Most generations start as short clips. You can extend clips in sequence to create longer scenes and merge shots into a continuous edit.
Is Krea's AI video generator free?
Yes. Krea includes a free tier so you can try AI video generation before upgrading. Paid plans unlock more compute and higher usage limits.
What makes a good AI video prompt?
Use a clear subject, action, and setting, then add camera language such as angle, movement, lens style, lighting, and mood. Start simple, generate, and iterate with small prompt changes for more control.
Can I turn a prompt into a video for free?
Yes. Open the Video Tool , type your prompt, pick a model, and generate. Krea's free tier includes compute so you can create prompt to video clips at no cost, and paid plans unlock more generations and faster queues.
What is the difference between text to video and image to video?
Text to video creates a clip from a written description alone. Image to video starts from a still image, such as a photo, render, or AI-generated frame, and animates it with the motion you describe. Krea supports both, including first and last frame control for image to video.
Can I use Krea as an AI video maker?
Yes. Krea lets you create AI videos from text prompts or images, compare models, extend or merge clips, and generate sound on supported models in one workspace.
Can I use Seedance 2.5 in Krea?
Yes. Seedance 2.5 is available in Krea for AI video generation. Explore the model page to see current capabilities, or open the Video Tool with Seedance 2.5 selected.
